feat: consumable management for platform and App Studio (#65)

* feat: add consumable ownership model and management APIs

Introduce platform/App consumable tables with soft selection, categories,
translations, assets, and purchase entries, plus shared management endpoints.

* fix: register consumable lifecycle routes without path collisions

Split enable/disable handlers onto distinct paths so OpenAPI routing no longer
overlaps identical POST method trees.

* feat: add shared consumable workspace for platform and App Studio

Reuse one workspace component with scope capabilities, wire menus and
permissions, and refresh the typed management client for the new APIs.

* feat: show which Apps selected a platform consumable

Add a platform selections endpoint and surface active App selections in the
shared consumable editor so operators can audit adoption without App edits.

* fix: tighten consumable selection and purchase fallback rules

Block assigning disabled categories, keep App lists to owned plus selected
platform rows, harden select upserts against inactive platform items, and stop
purchase resolution from returning cross-region defaults.

* fix: renumber consumable migration after device lifecycle series

Avoid colliding with main's 202608310001-007 migrations by moving consumable
schema to 202608310008.
